video_title: Caleb Wilson says being at the Finals is INSPIRING HIM to get his team there one day 🤩 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson on the motivation of being at the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I want to be in the finals one day, so having an opportunity to be here is a blessing.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: How do you digest all of this, knowing the draft is around the corner?

text_blocks.speaker: Caleb Wilson
text_blocks.text: It is really exciting. I want to be in the finals one day, so having an opportunity to be here is a blessing. I am going to be there soon, so I am just hyped for it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins challenges Caleb Wilson on his draft stock
quotes.excerpt: Make a campaign for yourself on why you should be the number one pick.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I have been seeing over the last few weeks our experts got you going number four. I have been seeing AJ Dybantsa going on this media run and every time I listen to him, he is talking about why he should be the number one pick. Make a campaign for yourself on why you should be the number one pick. Do you believe you should be the number one pick?

text_blocks.speaker: Caleb Wilson
text_blocks.text: I definitely do. I played against everybody else and I won and I played better. It is just that simple for me.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes asks Caleb Wilson about potentially joining the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: If you were to get to an organization like that and it was to be in a bigger market, how do you feel like you can step in and help?

text_blocks.speaker: Harrison Barnes
text_blocks.text: Within the projection, you could end up going to Chicago. As a Chicago guy, I know you have seen a lot of the stuff that has been happening with the Bulls. If you were to get to an organization like that and it was to be in a bigger market, how do you feel like you can step in and help?

text_blocks.speaker: Caleb Wilson
text_blocks.text: I am a winner. I am going to change that culture and I am going to bring it back to what it was for sure. It is a great pipeline, North Carolina to Chicago.
